overview: The City Council rejected a proposed mixed-use zoning amendment, referred an amended brewery ordinance to the Community Development Board, and placed a resolution regarding a Black Lives Matter banner on file while requesting municipal banner policies from the mayor. The council also approved several grants of location, capital appropriations, and an election polling site change during a lengthy meeting.

items.title: Public Hearing: Multi-Dwelling Non-Residential Zoning Amendment (20-381)
items.summary: Rejected a proposed zoning amendment to require non-residential uses and special permits for multi-family developments.

items.title: Public Hearing: Adult-Use Marijuana Establishments Zoning (20-042)
items.summary: Continued the public hearing to August 25 to allow review of Community Development Board recommendations in a Committee of the Whole meeting.

items.title: Public Hearing: Tufts University Grant of Location on Boston Avenue (20-478)
items.summary: Approved a grant of location to install an underground electrical transmission line beneath Boston Avenue, with an amendment requiring designated project contacts and a city clerk of the works.

items.title: Withdrawn Resolutions (20-483 and 20-487)
items.summary: Noted the withdrawal of papers 20-483 and 20-487 by the sponsor.

items.title: Discussion on Future of Medford Fire Headquarters (20-484)
items.summary: Approved a resolution to hold a Committee of the Whole meeting on the future of the Medford Fire Headquarters with administrative, union, and department officials.

items.title: Notification of Site Plan Review Applications (20-485)
items.summary: Approved a directive to the City Clerk to transmit Site Plan Review filings to the council within seven days, alongside an approved companion motion to include correspondence from Tufts University.

items.title: Police Chief Report on July 4 Incidents (20-486)
items.summary: Approved a request for a report from the Police Chief regarding fireworks and disturbances that occurred on July 4.

items.title: Condolences and Meeting Dedication for Elaine Honeycutt (20-488)
items.summary: Approved a resolution extending condolences to the family of Elaine Honeycutt and dedicated the meeting in her memory following a moment of silence.

items.title: Arlington Catholic High School Graduation at Hormel Stadium (20-489)
items.summary: Placed on file a resolution regarding the scheduling of graduation ceremonies at Hormel Stadium after the matter was resolved.

items.title: Public Hearing: Comcast Grant of Location on Riverside Avenue (20-481)
items.summary: Approved Comcast's petition to install underground conduit on Riverside Avenue to serve the Hyatt Hotel, following conditions set by the city engineer.

items.title: Traffic Calming and Signage on Washington and Spring Streets (20-490)
items.summary: Referred requests for traffic calming, signage, and a comprehensive study to the Traffic Commission, amending the measure to ask for a citywide approach.

items.title: Demolition Delay Ordinance and Building Permit Procedures (20-491)
items.summary: Requested written guidelines from the Building Commissioner and scheduled a Committee of the Whole meeting with the Historical Commission and administration, while passing a companion paper asking how many historic homes have been preserved under the delay ordinance.

items.title: Pine Ridge Road Weekend Parking and Private Ways (20-492)
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting enforcement and temporary barriers for weekend lake parking on Pine Ridge Road, a legal opinion on private ways, and consideration of the Shared Streets program.

items.title: Pedestrian Safety and Crosswalks on Elm Street (20-493)
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the Department of Conservation and Recreation to install and repaint crosswalks by Wright's Pond, amended to request a municipal traffic study.

items.title: Black Lives Matter Banner on City Hall (20-497)
items.summary: Voted to place the resolution calling for a Black Lives Matter banner on City Hall on file, and adopted a second motion requesting that the mayor provide the standards and procedures used to govern displays on municipal buildings.

items.title: Tufts University Campus Reopening Update (20-498)
items.summary: Approved a request for an update from the administration and health officials regarding safety protocols for returning college students.

items.title: Financial Approvals: Gift Account and CPA Appropriation (20-494 and 20-495)
items.summary: Approved a gift expenditure account for the Council on Aging and appropriated $3,083.50 in Community Preservation Act reserve funds for the bocce court project.

items.title: Brewery and Brewpub Zoning Amendment (19-481)
items.summary: Adopted an amendment adding a definition for brewpubs as restaurants and referred the revised brewery zoning ordinance to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Relocation of Ward 3, Precinct 1 Polling Place (20-472)
items.summary: Approved moving the Ward 3, Precinct 1 polling place to the American Legion Post on Winthrop Street due to construction and pandemic concerns at Lawrence Memorial Hospital.

items.title: Seasonal Food Truck Licensing Program (20-496)
items.summary: Approved a temporary pilot program authorizing up to five pre-ordered food truck neighborhood dates between August and October.

items.title: Public Hearings: National Grid Grants of Location (20-479 and 20-480)
items.summary: Approved grants of location for National Grid to relocate a pole on Winthrop Street and to install underground conduit on Salem Street.

items.title: COVID-19 Health Metrics and City Reopening Status (20-499)
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the administration for a written update on COVID-19 health data and whether city reopening phases should be slowed.

items.title: Municipal Website Review Committee of the Whole (20-500)
items.summary: Approved a request to convene a Committee of the Whole meeting with administrative staff to review city website updates.

items.title: Committee Reports, Public Participation, and Meeting Records
items.summary: Approved multiple fiscal year 2021 budget committee reports, adopted a motion to make best efforts to schedule a gender equity commission hearing following resident comment, and approved the minutes of June 30.
